class CacheError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all cache-related errors."""
    pass


class CacheFullError(CacheError):
    """Raised when the cache is full and cannot accept new entries."""
    pass


class CacheKeyError(CacheError):
    """Raised when a cache key is invalid or missing."""
    pass


class CacheValueError(CacheError):
    """Raised when a cache value is invalid or cannot be stored."""
    pass


class CacheTTLExpiredError(CacheError):
    """Raised when attempting to access a TTL-expired cache entry."""
    pass


class CacheCapacityError(CacheError):
    """Raised when cache capacity is exceeded during write operations."""
    pass
